title: Unifying Goal-Conditioned RL and Unsupervised Skill Learning via Control-Maximization
abstract: arXiv:2605.06145v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unsupervised pretraining has driven empirical advances in goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), but its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In particular, an influential class of methods, mutual information skill learning (MISL), discovers behaviorally diverse skills that can later be used for downstream goal-reaching. However, it remains a theoretical mystery why skills learned through MISL should support goal-reaching. A subtle challenge is that both GCRL and MISL are umbrella terms: Different GCRL tasks use distinct criteria for measuring goal-reaching performance, while different MISL methods optimize distinct notions of behavioral diversity. We address this challenge and unify GCRL and MISL as instances of control maximization. We identify three canonical GCRL formulations and prove that they are fundamentally inequivalent: They can induce incompatible optimal policies even in the same environment. Nevert

translated_title: 通过控制最大化统一目标条件强化学习与无监督技能学习
translated_abstract: 无监督预训练已推动目标条件强化学习（GCRL）取得了经验上的进展，但其理论基础仍缺乏深入理解。特别是，一类有影响力的方法——互信息技能学习（MISL），能够发现行为多样的技能，这些技能随后可用于下游的目标达成任务。然而，为什么通过MISL学到的技能能够支持目标达成，这在理论上仍是一个谜。一个微妙的挑战在于，GCRL和MISL都是伞形术语：不同的GCRL任务采用不同的标准来衡量目标达成性能，而不同的MISL方法则优化不同的行为多样性概念。我们应对这一挑战，将GCRL和MISL统一为控制最大化的实例。我们识别出三种典型的GCRL公式，并证明它们在根本上是不可等价的：即使在相同环境中，它们也可能导出互不相容的最优策略。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将目标条件强化学习（GCRL）与互信息技能学习（MISL）统一在控制最大化框架之下，并证明三种典型的GCRL公式在根本上是不可等价的，为无监督技能学习为何能支持下游目标达成任务提供了理论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies goal-conditioned RL (GCRL) and mutual information skill learning (MISL) as instances of control maximization, and proves that three canonical GCRL formulations are fundamentally inequivalent, providing theoretical foundations for why unsupervised skill learning supports downstream goal-reaching.
